label: Bible Study
prompt: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I _____, that do I.
verse: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
note: Paul's honest confession of the inner tug-of-war — anyone who's tried to change can relate.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual _____.
verse: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
note: The afflicted have hard days, but a merry heart hath a continual feast — cheerfulness eats well.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The _____ of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verse: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
note: God's promise to the widow: the barrel of meal won't run out and the oil won't fail until the rain comes.

label: Deep Water
prompt: We hanged our _____ upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verse: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
note: The captors asked for songs of Zion; the exiles hung up their instruments instead.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the _____ of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verse: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
note: Jesus' diagnosis of speech: the mouth only says what the heart is overflowing with — out of its 'abundance.'
